requirements.requirement:

interoperability with both OAuth 2.0 Authorization Server

requirements.requirement: For issuer URLs with path components (e.g., `https://auth.example.com/tenant1`), clients **MUST** try endpoints in the following priority order OpenID Connect Discovery 1.0 with path insertion: `https://auth.example.com/.well-known/openid-configuration/tenant1`

requirements.requirement:
MCP servers **MUST** validate that access tokens were issued specifically for them as the intended audience,
according to [RFC 8707 Section 2](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8707.html#section-2).
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
If validation fails, servers **MUST** respond according to
[OAuth 2.1 Section 5.3](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-oauth-v2-1-13#section-5.3)
error handling requirements.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
Invalid or expired tokens **MUST** receive a HTTP 401
response.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: MCP clients **MUST NOT** send tokens to the MCP server other than ones issued by the MCP server's authorization server.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
MCP servers **MUST** only accept tokens that are valid for use with their
own resources.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: MCP servers **MUST NOT** accept or transit any other tokens.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: - **MUST** keep refresh tokens confidential in transit and storage as specified in [OAuth 2.1 Section 4.3](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-oauth-v2-1-14#section-4.3)
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: - **SHOULD** include `refresh_token` in their `grant_types` client metadata
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: - **MAY** add `offline_access` to the `scope` parameter of the authorization and token requests when the Authorization Server metadata contains it in `scopes_supported`
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: - **MUST NOT** assume refresh tokens will be issued; the AS retains discretion
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
**MCP Servers** (Protected Resources) **SHOULD NOT** include `offline_access` in
`WWW-Authenticate` scope or Protected Resource Metadata `scopes_supported`, as refresh
tokens are not a resource requirement.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: Servers **MUST** return appropriate HTTP status codes for authorization errors:
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: When a client makes a request with an access token with insufficient scope during runtime operations, the server **SHOULD** respond with `HTTP 403 Forbidden` status code (per [RFC 6750 Section 3.1](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6750#section-3.1))
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: When a client makes a request with an access token with insufficient scope during runtime operations, the server **SHOULD** respond with `WWW-Authenticate` header with the `Bearer` scheme and additional parameters:
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: When a client makes a request with an access token with insufficient scope during runtime operations, the server **SHOULD** respond with `error="insufficient_scope"` - indicating the specific type of authorization failure
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: When a client makes a request with an access token with insufficient scope during runtime operations, the server **SHOULD** respond with `scope="required_scope1 required_scope2"` - specifying the minimum scopes needed for the operation
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: When a client makes a request with an access token with insufficient scope during runtime operations, the server **SHOULD** respond with `resource_metadata` - the URI of the Protected Resource Metadata document (for consistency with 401 responses)
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: When a client makes a request with an access token with insufficient scope during runtime operations, the server **SHOULD** respond with `error_description` (optional) - human-readable description of the error
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
**Server Scope Management**: When responding with insufficient scope errors, servers
**SHOULD** include the scopes needed to satisfy the current operation in the `scope`
parameter, consistent with
[RFC 6750 Section 3.1](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6750#section-3.1).
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
Whatever scope-inclusion strategy a server adopts, servers **SHOULD** include all
scopes required for the current operation in a single challenge.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: Servers **SHOULD** be consistent in their scope inclusion strategy to provide predictable behavior for clients.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
Servers **SHOULD** consider the user experience impact when determining which scopes to include in the
response, as misconfigured scopes may require frequent user interaction.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: Clients **SHOULD** respond to these errors by requesting a new access token with an increased set of scopes via a step-up authorization flow or handle the errors in other, appropriate ways.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: Clients acting on behalf of a user **SHOULD** attempt the step-up authorization flow.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
Clients acting on their own behalf (`client_credentials` clients)
**MAY** attempt the step-up authorization flow or abort the request immediately.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
Clients **MAY** also consult the
   [Scope Selection Strategy](#scope-selection-strategy) for
   initial scope selection guidance.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: Clients **SHOULD** implement retry limits
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
**SHOULD** track scope upgrade attempts to avoid
repeated failures for the same resource and operation combination.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
Servers **MUST** account for scope hierarchies, where a broader scope implies narrower ones, when
deciding whether a token is sufficient for an operation.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
Implementations of this specification **MUST** follow the normative security
requirements in [Security Considerations](/specification/2026-07-28/basic/authorization/security-considerations),
covering token audience binding and validation, token theft, communication security,
authorization code protection, mix-up and confused deputy attacks, open redirection,
and Client ID Metadata Document security.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
This document outlines security requirements that implementers **MUST** consider when
building MCP clients and servers.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
Additionally, implementors **MUST** follow OAuth 2.1 security best practices as outlined in
[OAuth 2.1 Section 7. "Security Considerations"](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-oauth-v2-1-13#name-security-considerations).
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: - MCP clients **MUST** include the `resource` parameter in authorization and token requests as specified in the [Resource Parameter Implementation](/specification/2026-07-28/basic/authorization#resource-parameter-implementation) section
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: - MCP servers **MUST** validate that tokens presented to them were specifically issued for their use
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
Clients and servers **MUST** implement secure token storage and follow OAuth best practices,
as outlined in [OAuth 2.1, Section 7.1](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-oauth-v2-1-13#section-7.1).
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: Authorization servers **SHOULD** issue short-lived access tokens to reduce the impact of leaked tokens.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: For public clients, authorization servers **MUST** rotate refresh tokens as described in [OAuth 2.1 Section 4.3.1 "Token Endpoint Extension"](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-oauth-v2-1-13#section-4.3.1).
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: Implementations **MUST** follow [OAuth 2.1 Section 1.5 "Communication Security"](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-oauth-v2-1-13#section-1.5).
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: All authorization server endpoints **MUST** be served over HTTPS.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: All redirect URIs **MUST** be either `localhost` or use HTTPS.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: To mitigate this, MCP clients **MUST** implement PKCE according to [OAuth 2.1 Section 7.5.2](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-oauth-v2-1-13#section-7.5.2)
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: **MUST** verify PKCE support before proceeding with authorization.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: MCP clients **MUST** use the `S256` code challenge method when technically capable, as required by [OAuth 2.1 Section 4.1.1](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-oauth-v2-1-13#section-4.1.1).
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: Since OAuth 2.1 and PKCE specifications do not define a mechanism for clients to discover PKCE support, MCP clients **MUST** rely on authorization server metadata to verify this capability **OAuth 2.0 Authorization Server Metadata**: If `code_challenge_methods_supported` is absent, the authorization server does not support PKCE and MCP clients **MUST** refuse to proceed.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: Since OAuth 2.1 and PKCE specifications do not define a mechanism for clients to discover PKCE support, MCP clients **MUST** rely on authorization server metadata to verify this capability **OpenID Connect Discovery 1.0**: While the [OpenID Provider Metadata](https://openid.net/specs/openid-connect-discovery-1_0.html#ProviderMetadata) does not define `code_challenge_methods_supported`, this field is commonly included by OpenID providers. MCP clients **MUST** verify the presence of `code_challenge_methods_supported` in the provider metadata response. If the field is absent, MCP clients **MUST** refuse to proceed.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: Authorization servers providing OpenID Connect Discovery 1.0 **MUST** include `code_challenge_methods_supported` in their metadata to ensure MCP compatibility.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: MCP clients **MUST** have redirect URIs registered with the authorization server.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: Authorization servers **MUST** validate exact redirect URIs against pre-registered values to prevent redirection attacks.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
MCP clients **SHOULD** use and verify state parameters in the authorization code flow
and discard any results that do not include or have a mismatch with the original state.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: Authorization servers **MUST** take precautions to prevent redirecting user agents to untrusted URI's, following suggestions laid out in [OAuth 2.1 Section 7.12.2](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-oauth-v2-1-13#section-7.12.2)
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: Authorization servers **SHOULD** only automatically redirect the user agent if it trusts the redirection URI.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: If the URI is not trusted, the authorization server MAY inform the user and rely on the user to make the correct decision.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
When implementing [Client ID Metadata Documents](/specification/2026-07-28/basic/authorization/client-registration#client-id-metadata-documents), authorization servers **MUST** consider the security implications
detailed in [OAuth Client ID Metadata Document, Section 6](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-oauth-client-id-metadata-document-00#name-security-considerations).
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
Authorization servers fetching metadata documents **SHOULD** consider
[Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/Security/Attacks/SSRF) risks, as described in [OAuth Client ID Metadata Document: Server Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Attacks](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-oauth-client-id-metadata-document-00#name-server-side-request-forgery).
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: - **SHOULD** display additional warnings for `localhost`-only redirect URIs
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: - **MAY** require additional attestation mechanisms for enhanced security
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: - **MUST** clearly display the redirect URI hostname during authorization
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: Authorization servers **MAY** implement domain-based trust policies for accepting Client ID Metadata Documents, as described in [Section 6.4](https://www.ietf.org/archive/id/draft-ietf-oauth-client-id-metadata-document-00.html#section-6.4) and [Section 6.8](https://www.ietf.org/archive/id/draft-ietf-oauth-client-id-metadata-document-00.html#section-6.8) of the Client ID Metadata Document specification.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
MCP proxy servers using static client IDs **MUST** obtain user consent for each
[dynamically registered client](/specification/2026-07-28/basic/authorization/client-registration#dynamic-client-registration)
before forwarding to third-party authorization servers (which may require additional consent).
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: MCP servers **MUST** validate access tokens before processing the request, ensuring the access token is issued specifically for the MCP server, and take all necessary steps to ensure no data is returned to unauthorized parties.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: A MCP server **MUST** follow the guidelines in [OAuth 2.1 - Section 5.2](https://www.ietf.org/archive/id/draft-ietf-oauth-v2-1-13.html#section-5.2) to validate inbound tokens.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: MCP servers **MUST** only accept tokens specifically intended for themselves
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: **MUST** reject tokens that do not include them in the audience claim or otherwise verify that they are the intended recipient of the token.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: The MCP server **MUST NOT** pass through the token it received from the MCP client.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
MCP clients **MUST** implement and use the `resource` parameter as defined in [RFC 8707 - Resource Indicators for OAuth 2.0](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8707.html)
to explicitly specify the target resource for which the token is being requested.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
All implementations **MUST** support the base protocol, versioning,
and the message patterns.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
Other components **MAY** be implemented based on the specific needs of the
application.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
All messages between MCP clients and servers **MUST** follow the
[JSON-RPC 2.0](https://www.jsonrpc.org/specification) specification.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: - Requests **MUST** include a string or integer ID.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: - Unlike base JSON-RPC, the ID **MUST NOT** be `null`.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
- The request ID **MUST NOT** match the ID of any other request the sender has issued and
  not yet received a response for.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: - Result responses **MUST** include the same ID as the request they correspond to.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: - Result responses **MUST** include a `result` field.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: - The `result` **MAY** follow any JSON object structure.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: - The `result` **MUST** include a `resultType` field to indicate the type of the result.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: - Extensions **MAY** add additional `ResultType` values.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: The set of supported `ResultType` values **MUST** be created from the set defined in the core protocol and include any additional values of supported extensions that are advertised via capabilities.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: - A `resultType` of any value unrecognized by the client **MUST** be considered invalid.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: - For backward compatibility with servers implementing earlier protocol versions, which do not include `resultType`, clients **MUST** treat an absent `resultType` as `"complete"`.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: - Error responses **MUST** include the same ID as the request they correspond to (except in error cases where the ID could not be read due a malformed request).
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: - Error responses **MUST** include an `error` field with a `code` and `message`.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: - Error codes **MUST** be integers.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
- Error responses **MAY** include a `data` member with additional information of any type, such
  as nested errors.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
New codes **MUST NOT** be
  allocated in this sub-range
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
new implementations **SHOULD NOT** use codes
  from this sub-range at all.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
Apart from `-32002` (see below), receivers
  **MUST NOT** assume any specific meaning for these codes.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
Implementations
  **MUST NOT** emit any code from this sub-range that is not defined by this
  specification
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
**MUST** use defined codes only with their specified
  meanings.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: Codes defined by earlier protocol versions remain reserved and will not be reused. Implementations of this protocol version **MUST NOT** emit these codes `-32002` — resource not found (2025-11-25 and earlier; replaced by `-32602`). Clients [**SHOULD** still accept `-32002`](/specification/2026-07-28/server/resources#error-handling) from servers implementing earlier versions.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: Codes defined by earlier protocol versions remain reserved and will not be reused. Implementations of this protocol version **MUST NOT** emit these codes `-32042` — URL elicitation required (2025-11-25 only).
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
New error codes for purposes not defined by this specification **SHOULD** be
allocated outside the JSON-RPC reserved range (`-32768` to `-32000`); the
remainder of the integer space is available for application-defined errors.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: The receiver **MUST NOT** send a response.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: - Notifications **MUST NOT** include an ID.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
- Servers **MUST NOT** rely on prior requests over the same connection to
  establish context (e.g., capabilities, protocol version, client identity).
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
- Servers **SHOULD** be prepared to handle requests associated with multiple
  tasks, threads, or conversations.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
- Servers **SHOULD NOT** require that a client reuse the same connection or process to
  perform related operations.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
- Clients **SHOULD NOT** use an individual task, thread, or conversation as the
  lifetime boundary for the stdio process.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
- State that needs to span multiple requests (e.g., long-running tasks,
  application-level handles) **MUST** be referenced by an explicit identifier
  the client passes on each request.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: Implementations using an HTTP-based transport **SHOULD** conform to this specification,
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
whereas implementations using STDIO transport **SHOULD NOT** follow this specification,
and instead retrieve credentials from the environment.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
Additionally, clients and servers **MAY** negotiate their own custom authentication and
authorization strategies.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: **Explicit dialect**: Schemas MAY include a `$schema` field to specify a different dialect
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: **Supported dialects**: Implementations MUST support at least 2020-12
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: SHOULD document which additional dialects they support
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: **Recommendation**: Implementors are RECOMMENDED to use JSON Schema 2020-12.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: - Clients and servers **MUST** support JSON Schema 2020-12 for schemas without an explicit `$schema` field
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: - Clients and servers **MUST** validate schemas according to their declared or default dialect.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: They **MUST** handle unsupported dialects gracefully by returning an appropriate error indicating the dialect is not supported.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: - Clients and servers **SHOULD** document which schema dialects they support
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement: - Schemas **MUST** be valid according to their declared or default dialect
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
Implementations **MUST NOT**

notifications at or above the requested level on the response stream of that
request, before the final response.
requirements.applicability_reason: Normative source obligation inventoried; Labby applicability is assigned by the host mapping stage.

requirements.requirement:
`notifications/message` is request-scoped:
the server **MUST NOT** deliver it on a
[`subscriptions/listen`](/specification/2026-07-28/basic/patterns/subscriptions)
stream or on any stream other than the one carrying the response to the request
that set the log level.
